background.title: Somali Civil War
background.description: Ongoing civil war in East Africa
background.extract: The Somali Civil War is an ongoing civil war that is taking place in Somalia. It grew out of resistance to the military junta led by Siad Barre during the 1980s.
background.license: Wikipedia text is available under CC BY-SA 4.0

headlines.title: Somalia looks to the future as the UN's political mission closes
headlines.excerpt: “The story of the UN's political engagement in Somalia has been one of persistence, partnership and adaptation,” Raisedon Zenenga, the UN Secretary-General's Deputy Special Representative for Somalia has said, as three decades of UN political missions in the Horn of Africa…

headlines.title: World News in Brief: Ethiopians flee to Kenya amidst renewed conflict, new head of UN’s food programme, UN mission in Somalia concludes
headlines.excerpt: Around 36,600 people have fled into northern Kenya following an uptick in fighting on the Ethiopian side of the border.
